title: Associate Director Forecasting US Oncology
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The primary objective of this position is to lead the volume and sales forecast analytical process for AbbVie's Multiple Myeloma (MM) franchise. The medication is a 100% AbbVie-owned asset, and this role is built to scale with the franchise: beyond the launch indication, the forecast scope is expected to expand across additional oncology medication indications (e.g., earlier lines of therapy) and additional MM pipeline products as they advance toward launch.
Specifically, this position is responsible for developing accurate and timely projections of commercial product volumes for Plan, Update, LBE, LRP, Portfolio, and Actual submissions, as well as providing decision-making support and recommendations to Senior Management. As the MM portfolio grows, the role establishes the forecasting methodology, tools, and cadence that new indications and assets will inherit — making this a franchise-building position, not a single-product one.
The Associate Director builds and maintains deep knowledge of the business through focused partnership with internal AbbVie functions, including Marketing & Sales Management, Marketing Analytics & Business Insights (MABI), Market Access, and Commercial Finance.
Responsibilities:
Lead the month-end actual close process for the medication, including preparation of Price, Volume/Demand, and Pipeline variance and close commentary; communicate key drivers of performance.
Prepare, create, and review sales reporting and key-metric forecasting packages for the MM franchise.
Present monthly actual sales results and future-period volume forecasts to the Commercial VP and Marketing Directors.
Lead the development of accurate product sales projections for Plan, Update, LBE, LRP, and Portfolio submissions — using sound analytical assumptions and clear communication of rationale and methodology.
Build and own the forecast models that will scale across the medication indications and additional MM assets, establishing a consistent, auditable methodology for the franchise.
Provide ad-hoc analytical support across business needs, including launch and new-indication scenarios, channel/product-mix impacts, and other key business drivers.
Leverage working knowledge of technical areas — forecast modeling approaches (regression, patient-flow, etc.), financial modeling, market dynamics, primary market research, competitive intelligence, and syndicated data sources.
Partner with internal Commercial, Pricing, Finance, and MABI teams to address business issues and provide solutions, including defining the risks and opportunities associated with the forecast.
Coordinate a focused cadence of interactions with MABI, Market Access, and Marketing to keep forecast assumptions aligned to the latest market view.
Lead and develop the medication forecasting team, which is expected to grow with the MM portfolio; provide coaching and career-development opportunities to sustain a high-performing staff.
Drive a positive, productive, and inclusive culture in full alignment with AbbVie's ways of working and expected behaviors.
Required:
8 to 10 years of combined experience in analytics, forecasting, and/or financial planning and analysis.
Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Mathematics/Statistics, Business, Economics, Accounting, or Finance.
Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically, identify key issues, opportunities, and value drivers, and translate strategic insights into forecasts that drive business decisions.
Ability to use market research to discover and quantify the financial impact of marketing initiatives and competitive events.
Ability to triangulate a wide variety of data sets and analytics to inform forecasting in a clear and concise way.
Ability to solve business problems through proactive identification of issues and the collection, analysis, and interpretation of related data.
Experience leading and motivating a team in a dynamic business environment to achieve results and deliverables.
Experience supporting senior operating management.
Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; excellent communication and presentation skills.
Preferred:
MBA / Master's in Accounting or Finance and/or CPA.
Biopharma industry experience and/or experience supporting a commercial/marketing organization.
US Commercial experience and knowledge of the financial planning process.
Oncology / hematology (Multiple Myeloma) therapeutic-area familiarity.
Power BI, MS Access, SQL, Python, Workiva, and web-based analytical dashboard tools a plus.

•  Develop, implement and continuously improve global sourcing processes, category strategies and supplier strategies aligned with the division’s commercial, operational and technology priorities. Develop annual and long range sourcing plans.

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital and delivery partners, is building the infrastructure required to support frontier AI systems. The Data Center Engineering team defines repeatable technical standards and carries them through design, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness. The team works across data center facilities, power generation, compute infrastructure, construction, procurement, and operations to deliver reliable capacity at unprecedented scale and speed.

About the Role

We are seeking a Controls Engineer to design and integrate automation systems for on-site power generation serving large AI data center campuses. You will own control architecture and functional requirements across generation packages, balance-of-plant systems, electrical protection, microgrid controls, and data center monitoring. You will work from concept through factory testing, site commissioning, performance validation, and operational improvement.

Role focus: Control-system architecture, integration, and commissioning for on-site generation

Travel: 50%

Responsibilities

 - Define control-system architecture, functional design specifications, sequences of operation, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm philosophy, and interface requirements.

 - Integrate OEM controls, PLCs, DCS, SCADA, historian, microgrid controllers, protection systems, and data center BMS or EPMS platforms.

 - Develop and review I/O lists, network architecture, control narratives, graphics, alarm limits, interlocks, permissives, and fail-safe behavior.

 - Coordinate synchronization, load sharing, islanding, black start, load shedding, restoration, and generation-to-data-center operating modes.

 - Evaluate cybersecurity, redundancy, time synchronization, communications protocols, data quality, and remote-support requirements.

 - Lead or support software reviews, simulator testing, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, commissioning, and tuning.

 - Troubleshoot control-system and plant-performance issues and convert findings into corrective actions and reusable standards.

 - Partner with electrical, mechanical, CSA, IT, security, operations, OEM, EPC, and data center controls teams.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of controls, automation, or instrumentation engineering experience in power generation, industrial plants, utilities, or mission-critical infrastructure.

 - Strong experience with PLC, DCS, SCADA, historian, industrial-networking, and control-system integration.

 - Knowledge of generation controls, synchronization, load sharing, protective interfaces, process control, and safety interlocks.

 - Experience developing functional specifications, sequences, I/O, alarms, graphics, and factory or site test procedures.

 - Ability to troubleshoot across software, instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, communications, and operating-process boundaries.

 - Understanding of industrial cybersecurity, redundancy, failover, and change-control practices.

Preferred Skills

title: Data Center Controls Engineer (BMS / EPMS)
description:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the infrastructure foundation for the next generation of AI. The Data Center Engineering team defines the strategy, reference architectures, technical requirements, and delivery standards for the large-scale data centers that support OpenAI research, products, and infrastructure partners.

As a Data Center Controls Engineer, you will program, configure, integrate, and commission the controls systems that support high-density AI data centers. You will work hands-on with mechanical or electrical controls, partnering with mechanical, electrical, IT/networking, security, commissioning, operations, and external delivery teams.

About the Role

We are seeking hands-on, early-career controls engineers with practical experience in building management systems (BMS) and mechanical controls, or electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS) and electrical controls. This role focuses on implementing and commissioning control systems, including PLCs, field devices, instrumentation, and sequences of operation, rather than owning OT/IT network or cybersecurity architecture.

The ideal candidate has day-to-day experience programming and commissioning controls, ideally with a controls systems integrator. We welcome depth in either BMS/mechanical or EPMS/electrical controls; expertise in both is not required. You will work with experienced engineers and delivery partners to turn design requirements into reliable, tested systems.

Key Responsibilities

 - Program and configure PLCs and control systems for mechanical/BMS or electrical/EPMS applications in AI data center campuses.

 - Implement and test sequences of operation, control logic, alarms, and interlocks against approved functional requirements.

 - Review and maintain controls documentation, including control diagrams, I/O and point lists, instrumentation details, sequences of operation, and commissioning records.

 - Integrate field devices, sensors, instrumentation, equipment controllers, and supervisory systems; validate point mapping, communications, and data quality.

 - Maintain control programs, configuration backups, version history, change records, and rollback procedures to support safe commissioning and operations.

 - Partner with mechanical, electrical, IT/networking, cybersecurity, and operations teams to resolve integration issues and implement approved OT connectivity and security requirements.

 - Configure and troubleshoot relevant industrial communications, such as BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA, or IEC 61850, according to the system and controls discipline.

 - Work directly with controls integrators, equipment vendors, contractors, and commissioning teams to resolve programming, installation, and functional performance issues.

 - Execute and document factory and site acceptance testing, point-to-point checks, sequence verification, and integrated systems testing; troubleshoot control logic, instrumentation, alarms, and device communication failures.

Qualifications

 - Practical hands-on experience programming, configuring, integrating, or commissioning control systems in data centers, industrial automation, buildings, or other critical infrastructure environments.

 - Working knowledge of PLC programming and control logic, with the ability to implement and troubleshoot sequences of operation.

 - Experience in either BMS/mechanical controls or EPMS/electrical controls, with an understanding of the equipment and operating sequences in that discipline.

 - Experience configuring field devices and instrumentation, validating I/O and point mapping, and diagnosing control system behavior.

 - Working knowledge of relevant industrial communication protocols and basic OT networking needed to connect and troubleshoot control systems.

 - Ability to read control diagrams, equipment documentation, I/O lists, and functional specifications, and keep implementation records accurate.

 - Hands-on experience with functional testing, commissioning, and systematic troubleshooting using trends, alarms, logs, and field observations.

 - Ability to work closely with integrators, vendors, construction teams, and operations, communicate issues clearly, and follow safe work and change-control practices.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls or Automation Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills

 - Experience at a controls systems integrator, with regular responsibility for programming, configuration, field integration, and commissioning.

 - Experience delivering BMS/mechanical or EPMS/electrical controls for data centers or other mission-critical facilities.

 - Familiarity with supervisory controls, HMI/SCADA configuration, telemetry, and historian integrations.

 - Familiarity with OT cybersecurity practices and working with networking or security specialists to implement approved access and connectivity requirements.

 - Experience with scripting, APIs, or automation tools that improve controls testing, integration, documentation, or troubleshooting.

Work Environment and Travel

 - This role requires periodic travel to data center campuses, vendors, labs, construction sites, commissioning activities, and controls/network cutovers.

 - The engineer should be comfortable working across office, lab, construction, and live data center environments, including PPE, lockout/tagout, cyber hygiene, and change-control requirements.

 - Work may include time-sensitive support during commissioning, startup, vendor testing, cutovers, network changes, telemetry issues, automation failures, and operational events.

About the role
The Strategic Pricing Lead is a high-impact commercial role accountable for developing and executing pricing strategies across TA’s retail, fleet and wholesale fuels businesses. The role connects market, customer, competitor, supply and financial insights to improve profitable volume, margin and pricing execution at site, corridor, customer and network levels.
The role will accelerate TA’s move toward integrated, analytical and forward-looking pricing through stronger processes, advanced tools and disciplined performance management. It will partner across pricing, sales, operations, supply, trading, finance, technology, data and analytics, while building team capability and representing TA in wider pricing forums.
Key Responsibilities
Pricing strategy and value delivery
Develop clear pricing strategies, guardrails and actions for TA’s retail, fleet and wholesale channels.
Identify and prioritize opportunities to grow profitable volume, improve unit margin and reduce value leakage.
Connect channel decisions to total business value and support planning, forecasting and network decisions with pricing and market insight.
Retail, fleet and wholesale pricing
Develop site, market, corridor, customer and segment strategies across gasoline, diesel, DEF and relevant fuels products.
Improve competitive positioning, customer deal evaluation, renewals, repricing and wholesale offer decisions using market, customer, supply and cost-to-serve economics.
Partner with pricing operations and sales to convert insights into timely actions and review actual performance against the commercial case.
Data, analytics and technology
Define business requirements and lead adoption of pricing tools, including retail optimization, fleet deal optimization, segment pricing, corridor analysis and performance management.
Validate analytical outputs against market knowledge, address material data gaps and use pilots and structured test-and-learn activity to improve decisions.
Ensure new capabilities simplify and improve pricing execution rather than add unnecessary complexity.
Performance and governance
Establish measures across volume, margin, realization, competitiveness, retention, deal performance and leakage.
Lead reviews that explain performance drivers and produce clear actions at site, corridor, market, product, customer and channel levels.
Maintain a value pipeline with accountable owners, achievements and measured outcomes, and ensure decisions comply with laws, policies and controls.
Leadership and capability
Act as a commercial integrator across TA pricing, sales, operations, supply, finance, trading, data, analytics and technology.
Communicate recommendations clearly, influence senior and frontline interested parties, and constructively challenge practices that limit value.
Coach pricing analysts, promote common pricing methods and share relevant regional and global best practices.
Summary Decision Rights
Recommend pricing strategies, guardrails, interventions and capability priorities across the assigned TA scope.
Approve pricing actions within delegated authority and escalate decisions outside agreed commercial or risk parameters.
Recommend whether pilots or interventions should be stopped, adjusted or scaled, and provide operational pricing backup when required.
Final financial authorities will align with TA’s approved delegation-of-authority framework.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent commercial experience.
Mid level-Senior experience in pricing, commercial management, revenue management, trading, supply, sales, finance or another role directly influencing gross-margin delivery.
Strong commercial and analytical capability, with evidence of translating data and market insight into practical actions.
Experience developing or executing pricing strategy in a competitive, high-volume or margin-sensitive business.
Ability to diagnose performance, influence across functions and communicate recommendations to senior leaders.

MBA, postgraduate qualification or formal training in pricing, economics, analytics or optimization.
Fuels, convenience retail, fleet, wholesale, energy, commodity or transportation experience.
Experience across multiple pricing channels and with supply or trading teams.
Familiarity with pricing optimization, deal management, geospatial analysis, customer segmentation, machine learning or agile product delivery.
Experience implementing pricing tools and coaching analysts.
